title: PATCH: wc_curve448_init has no _ex variant — devId gap undocumented
description: The wolfprovider_devid.patch changes wc_InitRng in wp_ecx_kmgmt.c to use devId. But the key init function pointers in the ecx table (wc_curve448_init, wc_ed448_init, wc_curve25519_init, wc_ed25519_init) are called via WP_ECX_INIT function pointer type int(*)(void*). Only wc_curve25519_init_ex, wc_ed25519_init_ex, wc_ed448_init_ex exist; wc_curve448_init_ex does NOT exist in wolfCrypt. The patch does not address key init devId routing for any ecx key, only the RNG. Document this limitation in provider_patch/wolfprovider_devid.patch header comment and in a /* NOTE */ at the ecx table.
